summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temporary directory and then executes a bundled 727KB obfuscated file `math_init.js` under that runtime via `execFileSync`. The package advertises itself as a small React feature-spotlight styling helper, and `math_init.js` is not referenced by the declared library entry (`dist/index.js`); it exists only to be executed by the fetched alternate runtime at install time. `math_init.js` uses rotated string/opcode arrays and hex-mangled identifiers (e.g. `MmgoCP`, `WV8StW`, `n7gIxM`) with `// @bun @bun-cjs` framing, so its behavior is opaque to Node-based inspection of the installed tree. Installing the package therefore fetches a second language runtime and runs an obfuscated payload on the installer's host, with no relationship to the advertised React UI utility.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
